Optimize CEP parallel execution for maximum useful/value-weighted parallelism, not maximum Writer count. Choose the smallest number of coherent independent execution lanes that minimizes time-to-accepted-result while preserving quality, scope isolation and safe collision control. Do not fragment coherent work into many tiny Writers when fewer Writers or Controller-owned bounded execution achieves equal or better throughput. Use expected work size/duration, dependency/collision DAG, review/integration overhead and evidence burden to choose lane count.

decision: The current M0/A6 result must not be accepted, promoted, or treated as surface-complete where it loses or genericizes the governed identity, purpose, workflows, region composition, commands, state semantics, original recoverable reference value, or applicable Owner decisions of any CEP surface. Each surface must then compose the required shared owners through its own typed domain/data/provider truth and required TOP/TOOLBAR/LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT/BOTTOM/TRANSIENT roles. decision: For the post-M0 zero-loss rescue, use value-weighted balanced specialist execution rather than overloading a few broad Writers or fragmenting into gratuitous micro-Writers. Partition mutable work first by canonical owner/seam and collision boundary, then by coherent surface/domain family. Each specialist must have a bounded medium-sized workload, exact path/owner locks, current Owner decisions and matrix rows, and must return an exact delta/evidence package. After specialist results, use one bounded Coverage/Convergence Writer per coherent group to consume only Controller-approved deltas, close group-level omissions and real-consumer composition, then run an independent group audit before global convergence. Shared hotspots and final wiring remain serialized; sibling ZIP overlay is forbidden. Parallelism is optimized for time-to-complete accepted product quality, completeness and reviewability, not Writer count.

Shared global/family owners govern compatible Presentation grammar, placement, slots, pane/window/focus/overflow/responsive behavior and reusable interaction mechanics. They do not own or standardize every Surface's command inventory, labels, content, workflow, lifecycle, data, provider truth or semantic effects. Each SurfaceProfile and its domain/provider owners supply those Surface-specific truths through thin adapters and composition. Library is an accepted donor and normal consumer, not the universal semantic or action template. Learn inherits the maximum compatible Structured/Library mechanics while preserving Learning semantics; other Surfaces consume only the shared mechanics justified by their own identity. Toolbar composition is two-layered: a small explicitly classified universal action set plus Surface-specific contextual/domain actions and availability predicates.

Protect the current simple CEP stack from unproven expansion. The admitted baseline is Node.js/TypeScript, browser-native UI, local node:http transport, node:sqlite behind the existing persistence boundary, @xterm/xterm as Terminal renderer, the narrow C++17 Win32/ConPTY sidecar behind platform capabilities, and Playwright as development/test evidence tooling. A Writer may not add an application framework, ORM, database driver/service, queue, second application runtime, desktop shell, bridge technology or Product dependency unless an exact current requirement proves the existing stack cannot satisfy the needed function and the Controller records an explicit dependency-admission disposition. Compatible build/test/capture tool or version substitution is not Product-stack expansion. STACK_EXPANSION_LOCKED does not equal STACK_FROZEN; final freeze still requires accepted Windows/xterm/PTY/ConPTY and applicable platform capability proof.

For the long-lived CEP Writer GitHub repository, `main` is the Controller-bound Writer baseline branch, not a free Writer worktree and not automatic CEP acceptance authority. Every mutating Writer mission must start from an exact Controller-bound `main` commit and work on one mission-specific candidate branch. Writers may commit/push only to that bound candidate branch and must never push directly to `main`, merge to `main`, create a release, self-promote, or mutate live Controller governance. Product changes belong only to genuine Product paths. `cep-writer/` remains Controller-owned read-only task authority. Small textual Writer handoff/evidence may be written under the mission's bounded `writer-output/<mission>/` path; heavy ZIPs/screenshots/baselines are not committed unless a mission explicitly requires them. The Controller audits the exact candidate-branch HEAD. Only after Controller acceptance may the Controller integrate the admitted Product delta into `main`, update Drive acceptance/live state, and refresh the same `cep-writer/` task packet for the next mission. Git history preserves old packets; do not create accumulating Writer-history folders merely for lineage.

The long-lived CEP GitHub Writer repository must be self-contained for Writer execution inputs. `main` must carry the current Controller-bound Product baseline plus every reusable/current Writer-readable input that a competent Writer may need without fetching live Controller files from Google Drive: required build/test tooling, contracts/profiles, current governed visual-reference assets, applicable domain/oracle/technical references, Writer-relevant Owner-decision snapshots, protected-truth/acceptance rules, and repository workflow guidance. A mission branch inherits those inputs from exact `main` and adds only the exact immutable mission/task overlay and any additional task-specific input not already present. Required reference images/PDFs/fixtures are INPUTS and remain in GitHub even when relatively large; do not remove them merely to minimize repository size. If an essential input is too large for ordinary Git, provide a deterministic Writer-consumable projection in the repository and preserve the original in Drive, or use another Git-native mechanism only after proving all intended Writer environments can consume it. Writer execution must not depend on live Drive lookups for required task inputs. Google Drive remains canonical for live Controller state/governance and for heavy GENERATED OUTPUT custody such as candidate/evidence/baseline ZIPs, large screenshot result sets, videos, generated reports and other bulky evidence. Branches may commit small handoff/results/receipts that bind external Drive outputs by file ID, SHA-256, bytes, source/commit identity and classification. Before any Writer branch launches, Controller must run a self-containment gate proving every mission-required input resolves to an in-repository path with exact hash/classification and no required Drive-only dependency.

For CEP Writer/Controller visual work, browser/network/localhost navigation failure must be treated separately from browser launch, rendering, JavaScript/DOM execution, pointer/keyboard interaction, screenshot creation/inspection, video capture/validation, and genuine route/platform proof. A Writer must use the bounded local/offline recovery ladder in `WRITER_LOCAL_VISUAL_CAPTURE_AND_RENDERING_METHOD.md` before declaring visual capture blocked. Navigation-independent real-browser rendering from exact candidate bytes via `page.set_content()` or an equivalent in-memory path is valid fresh Presentation/interaction evidence when explicitly classified `NOT_GENUINE_ROUTE`; it does not prove HTTP routing, Back/Forward, network, or platform integration. Missing bundled browser/FFmpeg tooling may be satisfied by already-installed validated binaries or governed offline packages using temporary execution-only paths, without Product architecture/dependency mutation. Every material screenshot must be actually opened and visually inspected; material video must be structurally validated and representative states/transitions inspected where applicable. Localhost/browser route restriction alone is not a reason to stop screenshots/video or ask the Owner to capture them manually when another truthful local rendering path works.

For CEP Writers, especially CHATGPT_WRITER, the primary work loop is local execution and iterative Product improvement, not external evidence transport. Intermediate screenshots, crops, visual diffs, videos, logs, build outputs and comparison artifacts are execution scratch and remain local/ephemeral by default. Their first purpose is to help the Writer discover defects, compare current Product state against the governed reference component-by-component/state-by-state, implement the narrowest correct change, then rerender/recapture/reinspect until the result is clean. Only the final representative source-bound captures/results that materially support handoff/audit are promoted to durable evidence. The GitHub connector MUST NOT be used as a bulk-file, screenshot/video, per-file blob-assembly or general evidence-transfer channel when local execution plus bounded final custody suffices. GitHub carries Product source/delta, mission-bound authority inputs, and small receipts/handoffs; ChatGPT heavy generated outputs and candidate/evidence bundles go to Google Drive in one bounded final custody step when needed. Google AI Studio may use its governed candidate-branch evidence exception only because Drive output is unavailable there, and still should avoid intermediate evidence churn. Connector/tool limits are transport constraints, never a reason to spend the Writer's main effort on packaging, split uploads or repeated custody operations, and never a reason to change Product architecture. Prefer reference decomposition/cropping -> current capture -> region/state comparison -> diagnose -> fix -> recapture -> compare -> repeat, with final evidence promotion only after the Writer has used the loop to improve the Product.

For CEP CHATGPT_WRITER work after CORR02 C1, the default inbound execution path is one exact self-contained Writer Workspace Capsule rather than connector-driven per-file repository assembly. The Controller must resolve live authority first, bind the exact adjudicated parent/source, mission, applicable Owner decisions, profiles/oracles/references, writable/read-only/prohibited scope, falsification gates and Stop Gate, then build one capsule artifact containing an exact git bundle plus mission-bound authority inputs, manifest/checksums, bootstrap and offline verifier. The Writer downloads/verifies/materializes once and performs source inspection, editing, build/test/browser/visual iteration locally. Capsule breadth may include stable task-relevant knowledge but never widens mutation authority. Intermediate evidence remains local under OD-073; heavy final generated custody goes to Google Drive only when materially required. Workflow/artifact PASS never creates Product or acceptance authority. CORR02 C1 is explicitly grandfathered on its existing bcbb1ac2 packet and is not repackaged merely to adopt this method; the first downstream mission launched after Controller-clean C1 must use CAPSULE_V1 or an explicitly accepted successor.

For CEP CHATGPT_WRITER missions governed by the Workspace Capsule method, capsule preparation is a Controller responsibility, not a Writer setup task. Before handoff the Controller binds and packages the exact adjudicated source/branch, complete mission-bound authority/reference inputs, the applicable reusable harness/capture method, and—when Presentation/interaction comparison is material and technically available—a bounded source-bound Visual Bootstrap Pack containing initial current-parent screenshots, capture/raw receipts, viewport/state metadata, reference bindings and comparison-plan metadata. The Writer's normal first duty is download once -> verify -> materialize -> inspect the prebuilt baseline/reference mapping -> compare -> diagnose -> fix -> recapture locally -> compare again. Bootstrap screenshots are acceleration inputs only and never final acceptance evidence. If a needed state is missing/partial or bootstrap capture is unavailable, the Writer may use the packaged harness/method to recapture locally without rebuilding the capsule or using connector-driven per-file setup. Visual bootstrap generation must never use stale/unbound screenshots, fabricate PASS, widen mutation authority, or make Product architecture depend on transport/capture constraints.

For CEP Writer correction/repair continuations after a Writer has produced a source-bound candidate that the Controller has independently reconstructed/audited and explicitly retained as a salvageable correction base, the default continuation path is VERIFIED_INCREMENTAL_CONTINUATION rather than automatically rebuilding a full Writer Workspace Capsule. The Controller must bind the exact continuation parent HEAD/tree/Product-source identity, open findings, preserved closures, writable/read-only/prohibited scope, architecture/owner locks, required falsification/regression/evidence, output custody and Stop Gate in a lightweight continuation overlay. Continuation path order is: (A) the same Writer may continue directly from an existing worktree only after exact HEAD/tree/Product-source/clean-status verification; (B) a new Writer or lost/untrusted worktree reconstructs the exact candidate from the nearest already-verified Capsule/base plus the exact ordered candidate-delta/git-bundle chain, verifying every prerequisite, hash, ancestry and resulting identity; (C) a new full Capsule is built only when A/B are impossible or unsafe, reconstruction lineage is ambiguous/missing/materially cumbersome, required mission inputs/harness/reference bytes materially changed beyond safe overlay reuse, or fresh isolation materially improves correctness. Previous Writer candidates and evidence remain immutable lineage and are never overwritten; each correction produces a new successor candidate/handoff. A candidate used as a correction parent remains CANDIDATE_ONLY and gains no acceptance/promotion authority. Never use sibling-ZIP overlay or manual changed-file overlay to reconstruct lineage. This law applies across CEP phases and Writer correction loops; a genuinely new mission/lane still defaults to the full Capsule method unless Controller proves verified continuation is the safer exact path.
